SRC-348:R001.text: A new actionable attachment must route through START, not status or continue; preserve the original task bytes and refuse clearly when attachment transport is unavailable

SRC-348:R002.text: A requirement disposition must be canonically validated: a test-run PASS is not a requirement VERIFIED, terminal dispositions require clause-specific evidence, and evidence that is absent, unrelated or a blanket aggregate may not verify a clause

SRC-348:R003.text: Under a blocked or reauthentication-required gate, strictly read-only investigation is permitted and every state-changing bypass is prohibited; CLI replay of operator ingress must fail and authenticated operator-carrier ingress must be verified

SRC-348:R004.text: Audit ledgers must not be declarable as completely VERIFIED from aggregate pytest counts: test-node identities must be unique, bound to a source revision, and checked per mechanism with independently checkable terminal dispositions

SRC-348:R005.text: An operator requirement must be distinguishable from a requirement an agent derived from a larger specification: track operator_source, derived_requirement and agent_hypothesis as separate provenance classes and never present an inferred requirement as an original operator instruction

SRC-348:R006.text: The response contract must be enforced against actual output: the active reply language and style are bound to the session and validated, with no repeated tool execution on a format retry

SRC-348:R007.text: An authenticated native host adapter test must exist and the refusal must stay fail-closed when host identity or generation is unavailable

SRC-348:R008.text: The complete untruncated session export and the original handoff bytes must be obtained before full historical verification is claimed; declared versus actual message and part counts must be compared and missing records must never be read as proof that an action did not happen

SRC-348:R009.text: Do not reopen a remediated ticket without evidence that the defect survives on current HEAD; do not push without destination-specific publication authorization; do not forge, replay or bypass operator credentials or reauthorization; run nonintrusive tests only and never inject real mouse or keyboard input into the operator workstation
